thread:
kate-growth: Quick sync — StratusHub + Lakefront co-marketing for Integration Summit. Goal: joint webinar, short benchmark post, and a marketplace listing push. Need dates and lead routing decided today. :calendar:

maria-marketing: Sounds good. Prefer a demo-led session with a 10–12min benchmark block. Benchmark should highlight cost vs latency tradeoffs and integration value.

sam-devrel: I can run the demo showing Redwood Dedicated -> Stratus connector -> Lakefront marketplace flow. Need final model variant + prompt set by Tue EOD.

oliver-partnerships: Partners suggested late-April / mid-May. I can propose two dates and let partner ops pick. Also: confirm who hosts landing page (Redwood vs partner).

kate-growth: Propose May 9 or May 23. Redwood hosts the landing page; partners link to their marketplace listing. Timeline: assets done by Apr 26; rehearsal week of May 1.

maria-marketing: Draft benchmark hook: "Integration reduces inference ops by ~30% using prefix-KV caching + routing to cost-optimized variants, with minimal p95 impact." Can eng/bench provide concrete numbers?

sam-devrel: Quick sweep shows 24–32% token-cost reduction across our prompt corpus depending on distribution. I'll extract p50/p95 latencies, the sample prompt set, and a minimal repro command/snippet.

maria-marketing: Perfect — I'll convert that into a 300–400 word blog + a single benchmark slide for the deck.

oliver-partnerships: Lead routing ask from partners: mirrored leads in both SFDCs. Proposal: registration form captures email, company, role, interest (marketplace / dedicated / private), partner_code param. UTMs: utm_source=partner, utm_campaign=integration_summit_2026. partner_code maps to a webhook->partnerops flow.

kate-growth: Canonical mapping: utm_source=partner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=integration_summit_2026 + partner_code=STRATUS or LAKEFRONT. Payload fields: email, company, role, prod_interest, consent, demo_request (boolean). Routing: partner_code=STRATUS -> webhook to /hooks/stratus-sf and cc inbound-marketing@redwood.com.

sam-devrel: Confirming demo_request flag so devrel can triage incoming demo asks quickly.

oliver-partnerships: Legal note from partners: only hashed email + lead metadata shared until MOU signed. Add privacy blurb on landing page.

maria-marketing: Asset checklist (due Apr 26): 1) hero banner (300x250), 2) co-branded 5-slide deck, 3) benchmark blog draft, 4) registration form + webhook config, 5) speaker bios.

kate-growth: Draft headline: "Integration Summit: Cut inference costs with Redwood + StratusHub + Lakefront" CTA: Register for live demo & benchmark. Pinging design for hero.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created — Integration Summit (Redwood x StratusHub x Lakefront) — May 9, 2026 — host: kate-growth. https://cal.example/ev/abc123

maria-marketing: Rehearsal plan: tech check 30m, run-through 45m, slides Q/A 15m. Schedule rehearsal 48 hours before to cover time zones.

oliver-partnerships: Partner ops will confirm date by EOD. Adding @lena-stratus and @tom-lakefront to thread for visibility.

lena-stratus: May 9 works for StratusHub. We'll send logo + one-pager today.

tom-lakefront: May 9 good for Lakefront too. We'll share marketplace listing link and our partner_code=LAKEFRONT.

kate-growth: Locking May 9. Owners: Maria -> content; Sam -> demo & bench artifacts; Oliver -> partner onboarding & lead routing; Kate -> event page & timeline. Any blockers?

maria-marketing: None. Draft copy will land in #marketing-assets by Friday.

sam-devrel: Created Asana task DEVREL-612 for the model/prompt deliverables.

oliver-partnerships: I'll send webhook credentials and add the partner row to the onboarding sheet by Apr 20.

kate-growth: Thanks team. I'll post the landing page draft and the registration schema in this thread when ready. :rocket:
